question: In which of the following states is Kali Tiger Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kali Tiger Reserve is a Tiger Reserve located in the central portion of the Uttara Kannada (North Canara) district of **Karnataka.**__
 
• Kali Tiger Reserve was earlier known as **Dandeli-Anshi Tiger Reserve.**
 
• It was renamed Kali Tiger Reserve in December 2015.
 
• Kali Tiger Reserve is sandwiched between **Haliyal and Karwar forest divisions** in Karnataka.
 
• It comprises two important protected areas of the region namel**y Dandeli Wildlife Sanctuary and Anshi National Park. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The famous Tiger Reserves in **Karnataka **are:

 
 
• Bandipur Tiger Reserve.
 
• Bhadra Tiger Reserve.
 
• Nagarahole Tiger Reserve.
 
• Biligiriranga Swamy Tiger Reserve.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The famous Tiger Reserves in **Telangana** are:

 
 
• Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.
 
• Kawal Tiger Reserve.
 
• Amrabad Tiger Reserve.
 
 
 
• The famous Tiger Reserves in **Assam** are:
 
 
• Manas National Park.
 
• Kaziranga National Park.
 
• Orang National Park.
 
 
 
• The famous Tiger Reserves in **Arunachal Pradesh** are:
 
 
• Namdapha.
 
• Pakke.
 
• Kamlang.
